description: The GATED design-equivalence live check, config-driven , scaffold ONE project, then run each design role's PRODUCTION-body turn in the UNCONSTRAINED channel (Bash + scripts/lk, so the role's ./scripts/lk self-check runs exactly as production does), judge the output against the pin, and RESET the built .consort artifacts between roles. The workspace is NOT hardcoded here , databricksHost is the REQUIRED ${DATABRICKS_HOST} marker, which design-equivalence-support.ts exports from the ONE config home (resolveTestEnv -> .env.local.test.config) before loading this. Same scaffold-project / remove-project lifecycle as driver-green + the stockflow demo (a real Lakebase project is created for consistency even though the design roles never touch the DB, so the design reset is filesystem-only).
